# Test run record template

**Blank template — no result claimed.** Copy and fill for one actual run. Keep raw identifying captures private; put reviewed copies in the evidence directory only after checking secrets and images.

| Field | Record |
| --- | --- |
| Run ID / test case | TODO |
| Mode: controlled-live / replay / unit / test-only rule | TODO |
| UTC start/end and clock synchronization/offset | TODO |

| Preconditions and relevant baseline | TODO |

| Exact commands, execution host, time and exit codes | TODO |

| Action outcome / notification acceptance and visible delivery | TODO |

Write a short timeline, explain the observed result, and link each claim to actual reviewed evidence. Distinguish a missing event from a dependency failure. Do not convert a fixture, replay or LAB TEST signature into a production detection claim.
